description: Rust N-API candidate parity test fixture

testCases.name: exact_query_parity
testCases.description: Same query against Qdrant and Rust backend returns same candidate IDs in same order

testCases.name: score_parity
testCases.description: Raw scores differ by < 0.001 between backends (floating point rounding)

testCases.name: filtered_query_parity
testCases.description: Filter by workspace_revision matches both backends

testCases.name: packet_key_resolution
testCases.description: Rust candidateId (slot number) resolves to same packetKey as Qdrant

testCases.name: recall_at_k
testCases.description: Top-10 recall between Rust backend and cuVS brute force baseline >= 0.95
testCases.expectedBehavior: At least 9/10 candidates in Rust top-10 appear in brute force top-20
